[SWS_SM_00710] Registration of S2R Satellites at S2R Hub
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
An
S2R Satellite
instance shall register with the hub via
ara::sm::s2r::
S2RSatellite::Offer
. It is considered actively registered until
ara::sm::s2r::
S2RSatellite::StopOffer
is called.
⌋
